result.question: What did Elisha say the officer who did not believe him would not do?

readings.support: but you will not eat any of it

assessments.reason: Elisha says, “you will not eat any of it,” which in context refers to the foretold flour and barley (v.1), so “Eat any of it” matches “He would not eat any of the flour or barley.”

result.reason: Elisha’s statement “you will not eat any of it” directly answers that the officer would not eat any of the flour or barley.
